name: Análisis Espectral de Audio
algorithm: Audio Spectral Analysis — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method performs spectral analysis of audio signals for detecting AI-generated speech following Chen et al. (2020):

1. **Short - Time Fourier Transformada (STFT)**: The audio signal is windowed and transformed to produce a spectrogram. The time-frequency representation reveals the full spectral content of the speech signal, including harmonics, formants, and noise components.

2. **Espectral Envelope Análisis**: The spectral envelope (smoothed magnitude spectrum) is extracted per frame using cepstral methods. Natural speech exhibits specific spectral envelope shapes determined by vocal tract resonances. AI vocoders (WaveNet, HiFi-GAN) may produce spectral envelopes with subtle artifacts — missing spectral detail above certain frequencies or unnatural smoothness in spectral transitions.

3. **High - Frecuencia Content Evaluación**: Frequencies above 8 kHz are particularly informative for deepfake detection. Natural speech contains aperiodic high-frequency energy from fricatives and aspiration noise with specific spectral characteristics. Many AI voice synthesis systems produce truncated or artificially shaped high-frequency content, revealing the synthesis methodology.

4. **Mel - Frecuencia Análisis**: The spectrum is analyzed on the mel scale to capture perceptually relevant features. Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) and their delta/delta-delta derivatives are computed. AI-generated speech often shows statistical anomalies in MFCC distributions — particularly in higher-order coefficients capturing spectral detail.

5. **Espectral Flux & Continuity**: Frame-to-frame spectral changes (spectral flux) are measured. Natural speech shows characteristic flux patterns during phoneme transitions. AI-generated speech may exhibit unnaturally smooth spectral evolution or micro-discontinuities between vocoder frames, serving as detection indicators.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: frecuencia
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante audio spectral analysis analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Chen, T. et al. (2020). Generalization of Audio Deepfake Detection. Odyssey.
Chugh, K. et al. (2020). Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection. ACM MM.
